deque-basic
code:
from collections import deque
q = deque([1, 2])
q.append(3)
print(q, len(q), bool(q))
print(q.popleft(), q.popleft(), q)

name: deque-ends
code:
from collections import deque
q = deque()
q.append("a")
q.append("b")
q.appendleft("c")
print(q, q.pop(), q.popleft(), bool(q))

name: deque-rotate-extend
code:
from collections import deque
q = deque([1, 2, 3])
q.rotate(1)
q.extendleft([0])
print(q, q.count(1), 2 in q)

name: deque-maxlen
code:
